part.text:
Snapshot `21397593dfc62e186346d577951d1e8b25c61af7d4f0a760438219d7d4361303` — base `c47daa3`. Runtime unverified, review from diff only.

Verdict: not accepted as-is — progression gate + input/pause interactions need fixes.

Blockers / major:
- `lobby_tutorial.gd:_unhandled_key_input`: `F` skip/close dead while paused. Node default `INHERIT`, workshop pauses `SceneTree`. Repro: start tutorial, open workshop at Iris x=349, press `F` — nothing. Same if pause autoload holds pause.
- `lobby_tutorial.gd:_physics_process` also `INHERIT`, so steps 0-2 freeze while workshop/pause open — correct to freeze, but combined with above traps `F` intent.
- `lobby.gd:_can_board` blocks elevator while `_lobby_tutorial_is_active()`, but no in-world feedback. Repro: press `E` at elevator during steps 0-4 — silently ignored. Hint says `ELEVADOR APÓS TREINO` but elevator itself gives no reason.
- `lobby_tutorial.gd:_finish_tutorial` / `lobby.gd:_on_lobby_tutorial_completed`: failure paths in `start()` `push_warning` + `completed.emit()` immediately set `SESSION_TUTORIAL_META`. Repro: missing `LobbyUI`, missing `MovementController/BallLauncher/RacketController` — tutorial never retries this session, silently skipped.
- Copy vs accepted action mismatch step 4: `lobby_tutorial.gd:_on_swing_started` advances on swing start, copy says `mire quando a bola vier na sua direção`. Repro: step 4, right-click empty air — completes without ball/timing. Step 3 similar lesser: `launch_accepted` fires regardless of aim, copy says `mire`.
- Overlay layer unverified from snapshot: workshop `CanvasLayer@80` vs `get_node("LobbyUI")` layer unknown. If `LobbyUI<80` workshop covers tutorial; if `>80` tutorial covers workshop. No layer set in diff.

Minor / robustness:
- `lobby_tutorial.gd:_layout_panel`: manual `position/size=(panel_width,108)` with autowrap labels clips on narrow viewports. Repro: width <~500, 15px/11px text wraps past 108px.
- Portrait `48×48` shown at `68×68` `NEAREST`: non-integer `1.41x` uneven pixels; no fallback if `ResourceLoader.exists(PORTRAIT_PATH)` false — blank gap.
- Type refs `as MovementController/BallLauncher/RacketController` with no preload in snapshot — resolution unverified; if not global classes, parse fails.
- Jump carryover: `_jump_started` not reset on entering step 1. Repro: jump to finish step 0 movement, land after step 1 shows — auto-advances without new jump.
- No pad fallback: steps 3-4 require mouse, skip/close only `F` key via `_unhandled_key_input`; controller-only stuck at progression gate.
